question_text: A 26-year-old Caucasian G1 presents at 35 weeks gestation with mild vaginal bleeding. She reports no abdominal pain or uterine contractions. She received no prenatal care after 20 weeks gestation because she was traveling. Prior to the current pregnancy, she used oral contraception. At 22 years of age she underwent a cervical polypectomy. She has a 5 pack-year smoking history. The blood pressure is 115/70 mmHg, the heart rate is 88/min, the respiratory rate is 14/min, and the temperature is 36.7℃ (98℉). Abdominal palpation reveals no uterine tenderness or contractions. The fundus is palpable between the umbilicus and the xiphoid process. An ultrasound exam shows placental extension over the internal cervical os. Which of the following factors present in this patient is the risk factor for her condition?
